name: PHL-16 (PCH-191) modular MLRS
armament: Two modular pods: 370 mm (2x5) or 300 mm (2x4) guided rockets, or 750 mm Fire Dragon tactical missiles
protection: Armoured cab only. Game: light armour on cab/turret only; immune to small-calibre rounds; 7.62x54R and larger disable it; launchers destroy it.
visual_notes: Heavy 8x8 Wanshan truck with forward crew cab
Two rectangular box pods on a rotating rear launcher; pods swap by crane
Associated with the Eastern Theatre Command's long-range fires facing Taiwan
